scientific_question: Does one task-faithful cumulative effective-evidence scalar close the item-potential dynamics and recover the missing history-dependent remote magnitude?
v1_diagnosis: The rank-2 and unconstrained (s_t,x_t) bilinear transitions do not beat the accumulator, while remote influence direction remains correlated 0.81--0.82 with the full network but reaches only 25--35 percent of its magnitude. Local edge-plus-Gram compression is exact.
primary_hypothesis: The item potential is the main global relational state but needs one scalar cumulative confidence/history state. Evidence omitted from the global path changes that state and therefore changes the gain of later writes, producing remote reassembly without adding pair, query, Liu, posterior, or neural-state information.
claim_boundary: A pass supports the coupled reduced state (s_t,c_t,a_t) for the frozen eight-item generic distribution and Liu preservation backbones. It does not identify c_t as human confidence, a biological variable, a unique state, or a population-general algorithm. A failure rejects this one scalar energy-history augmentation and closes post hoc scalar history feature engineering.

frozen_state_equations.history_update: c_(t+1)=c_t+0.5*||x_t||_2^2; because x_t=m_t(e_i-e_j), the increment is exactly m_t^2
frozen_state_equations.local_state: Reuse the exact v1 a_(t+1)=a_t+s_t^L e_(r_t) and ell=K a_T without refitting or modification.
frozen_state_equations.information_boundary: c_t contains only prior effective global evidence magnitudes. It contains no item identity beyond x_t, block or absolute time label, query, true order, Liu behavior, posterior, full neural potential, P_t tensor, L_t tensor, or network seed.

data_and_split_contract.development_data: Read the 128 registered generic trajectories for each of seeds 2101, 2102, and 2103 from the frozen v1 NPZ. Use only valid prefixes identified by each stored length; NaN padding is forbidden from fitting.
data_and_split_contract.folds: Repeat the exact three leave-one-backbone-out folds from v1. Fit on two backbones and evaluate all 128 episodes from the third; networks and participants are never pooled for inference.
data_and_split_contract.preservation: After the three folds, fit once on all 384 development episodes and evaluate unchanged Liu backbones 2104 and 2105 under the same v1 local state, temperature, sampling, LOO, double-dissociation, and behavior-category contracts.
data_and_split_contract.neural_reextraction: Forbidden for development trajectories. The untouched Liu checkpoint replay may be used only to reconstruct the already registered preservation interface and full-field diagnostic; no checkpoint value enters the v2 fit.

fit_contract.features: Concatenate x_t and c_t*x_t in that order.
fit_contract.target: s_(t+1)-s_t in raw centered Hodge-potential units.
fit_contract.method: One closed-form float64 ridge regression with lambda=1e-6; no optimizer, restart, early stopping, feature scaling, model selection, or hyperparameter selection.
fit_contract.accumulator_null: The frozen v1 A*x accumulator fit on the same fold.
fit_contract.v1_candidate_comparison: Reuse the already written held-out v1 rank-2 metrics; do not rerun or refit v1.
fit_contract.runtime: GPU and one PyTorch intraop/interop thread are required only for the untouched Liu preservation replay; the closed-form v2 fit may run on CPU.

primary_estimands.one_step: Exactly the v1 MSE, NRMSE, candidate-to-accumulator ratio, and paired episode bootstrap, plus v2-minus-v1-rank2 MSE.
primary_estimands.trajectory: Exactly the v1 zero-initialized prefix cosine, terminal cosine, pair-order agreement, and centered RMSE ratio.
primary_estimands.remote: Exactly the v1 natural-minus-LOO all-pair correlation, disjoint magnitude ratio, and candidate-versus-accumulator remote MSE.
primary_estimands.scalar_state: Report c_T distribution and fitted B norm. Neither nonzero c nor nonzero B is sufficient evidence without all causal preservation gates.
primary_estimands.local_and_Liu: Reuse v1 local exactness and independently require the unchanged double-dissociation and nine-row category-preservation rules in 2104 and 2105.

primary_pass_rules.integrity: All source, v1 artifact, valid-slice finiteness, NaN-padding exclusion, gauge, fold, parameter, GPU preservation, and local exactness gates pass.
primary_pass_rules.one_step: In each held-out seed v2 NRMSE is at most 0.50, v2 MSE is at most 0.80 times accumulator MSE, the paired episode interval for v2-minus-accumulator lies below zero, and v2 MSE is lower than frozen v1 rank-2 MSE.
primary_pass_rules.trajectory: In each held-out seed median prefix cosine and mean terminal cosine are at least 0.95, terminal pair-order agreement is at least 0.90, and terminal centered RMSE ratio is at most 0.50.
primary_pass_rules.remote: In each held-out seed v2/full influence correlation is at least 0.70, disjoint magnitude ratio is in [0.50,1.50], and v2 remote MSE is below both accumulator and frozen v1 remote MSE.
primary_pass_rules.preservation: Separately in 2104 and 2105, the exact v1 double-dissociation rule and all nine frozen behavior flag pairs pass without treating newly improved human calibration as preservation.

outcome_tree.potential_plus_scalar_history_algorithm: All integrity and primary links pass in every mandatory backbone. Promote (s_t,c_t,a_t) within scope and proceed to separately frozen cross-task generalization.
outcome_tree.scalar_history_insufficient: Integrity passes but any primary link fails. Preserve exact local compression and any positive scalar link, close alternative scalar coverage/time/block/history feature engineering, and next ask whether a separately registered higher-dimensional latent state is required.
outcome_tree.noninterpretable: Any integrity or execution gate fails. Repair provenance or implementation without changing the scientific contract before interpretation.

stop_rules: Do not try cumulative count, absolute magnitude, block index, elapsed time, alternative normalization, interaction mixtures, ridge values, or nonlinear scalar transforms after seeing v2.
Do not change v1 artifacts, thresholds, behavior categories, local kernel, evidence access, temperature, checkpoint, or seed.
Do not begin cross-task generalization unless this or a later separately frozen reduced state passes.
